create_Lfm2MoeConfig: create an Lfm2MoeConfig instance with default LFM2 MoE model configuration parameters
initialize_model_with_Lfm2MoeConfig: initialize a Lfm2MoeModel using an Lfm2MoeConfig configuration object
configure_moe_expert_routing: configure MoE expert routing with num_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and routed_scaling_factor settings
configure_conv_and_dense_layers: configure conv_bias, conv_L_cache, and num_dense_layers for shallow layer architecture
customize_token_and_position_embeddings: customize vocab_size, max_position_embeddings, bos_token_id, eos_token_id, and pad_token_id settings
